correctness.rationale: An exact Pell matrix factorization yields M^(2r)-I=2T_rB with primitive B. Cassini's identity excludes odd primes outside T_r, while the two-adic parity excludes unaccounted powers of 2. The polynomial A(y,x+2y)-A(x,y)=14x^3 produces an integral quotient Phi satisfying 7S_n=T_r Phi_n. At primes of T_r other than 3 and 7, Phi_0 is a unit; at 7 it is a unit and cancels exactly one factor; at 3 all Phi_n vanish for 4|r but Phi_0 has valuation precisely one. Periods modulo 3 and 7 determine the trigger conditions. The cubic rank-four recurrence makes the infinite gcd computable from four windows. Exact checks for 480 lengths and 7200 further windows agree but are not used as proof.

originality.rationale: The primary 2023 Pell GCD study defines general power windows but proves first-power braid formulas and gives partial results for squares; its full-text Sections 4–6 contain no cubic formula. The 2024 Pell consecutive-sum paper handles first powers and fixed-multiple identities. The 2022 generalized Fibonacci paper handles squares, and classical Pell sequence tables do not imply the cubic valuation law. Searches for exact and equivalent cubic window descriptions found no covering theorem. Residual risk: undiscovered equivalent work.

value.rationale: This is an exact complete classification for a natural infinite family of third-power sliding-window gcds, directly motivated by a published framework studying first and second powers. The cubic antidifference produces a genuinely new exceptional denominator prime 7; a separate 3-adic lifting phenomenon occurs exactly at indices divisible by four. The two independent local triggers and the half-index braid provide structural content beyond routine termwise recurrence manipulation or finite enumeration.
